controlify.hunterboard.cobblemon_send.de: Cobblemon's "throw party Pokémon" key: sends out or recalls the selected Pokémon, starts a battle, and opens the interaction wheel when aiming at a player.
controlify.hunterboard.party_next.desc: Selects the next Pokémon of the party (Cobblemon's "down shift" key).
controlify.hunterboard.party_prev.desc: Selects the previous Pokémon of the party (Cobblemon's "up shift" key).
controlify.hunterboard.summary.desc: Opens Cobblemon's summary of the party.
